auth_notes: Create a Slack app; install it to obtain scoped tokens. OAuth is needed to obtain other users' tokens.

access.approval_gate: Workspace installation controls and Marketplace review apply according to distribution.

access.approval_gate: Application permissions require tenant admin consent. Delegated consent can also require an admin; sandbox eligibility is not universal.

blocker: Requires suitable tenant, licensing and consent; free sandbox eligibility cannot be assumed. Legacy Teams MCP is not a recommended new-production route.

api.breadth: Read file/layer structures, images, versions and usage data; comments and webhooks, with product/plan-specific capabilities.

mcp.notes: Scope: operational account data, not documentation-only search. Figma documents its remote MCP server at https://mcp.figma.com/mcp. Rate/access guide explicitly permits limited Starter usage. Some canvas writes outside drafts require a Full seat; AI tools can consume credits.

blocker: Self-use prototype possible, but Starter REST capacity is very small and public OAuth review/paid seat or feature requirements can block practical scale.
